style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley 55cm Pre-Lit Christmas Berry & Pinecone Eucalyptus Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Welcome guests in festive style with our indoor outdoor 60cm prelit white berry &amp; pinecone eucalyptus wreath, a timeless Christmas classic perfect for any front door or festive display. Lightly dusted with a snowy finish and adorned with white berries &amp; pinecones, our prelit wreath brings a touch of winter wonder to any space. Warm white Micro LED lights are woven throughout the frosted greenery, casting a soft, magical glow that’s perfect for creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere. Battery powered for easy placement, this wreath is ideal for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use – decorate doors, windows, mantels, or walls with ease. Whether you're refreshing your holiday décor or starting a new tradition, this elegant wreath is designed to bring festive charm to your home year after year.</p><ul><li>CLASSIC CHRISTMAS STYLE: This 55cm Charles Bentley Green Wreath adds timeless festive charm to your front door, windows, or interior spaces with its full, natural-looking greenery.</li><li>WARM WHITE LED LIGHTS: Prelit with soft, warm white LED bulbs to create a cosy and inviting glow throughout the festive season.</li><li>BATTERY OPERATED &amp; WIREFREE: Powered by batteries (not included), this wreath is easy to place anywhere – no plug sockets or unsightly cables needed.</li><li>SUITABLE FOR INDOOR &amp; OUTDOOR USE: Designed to be displayed inside or outside – perfect for doors, porches, fireplaces, or hallway walls.</li><li>Easy to store, this wreath provides seasonal use with simple styling and setup.</li></ul><ul><li>DIMENSIONS: Height: 55cm, Width: 55cm, Depth: 20cm</li><li>Weight: 1.2kg</li><li>50 timer bulbs</li><li>ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Batteries NOT included 3x AA required</li><li>Size: ONE</li></ul>
